subject: En Route Delivery Recommendation and Licensing Moratorium
overview: The committee recommended En Route Delivery for a host community agreement and discussed the possibility of a moratorium on future cannabis license applications.

items.title: En Route Delivery License Application
items.summary: The committee reviewed an application for a marijuana delivery-only license at 151 Mystic Ave, questioning the applicant on security, ID verification, and vehicle nondescriptness. Recommended the applicant to the Mayor for a host community agreement.

items.title: Proposed Licensing Moratorium
items.summary: Members discussed recommending a moratorium on new cannabis licenses to evaluate the community impact of current approvals once they become operational. The chair will consult with legal counsel regarding the committee's authority to propose such a pause to the City Council.
